confidence_notes: The FX figure is the RBA rate for 18 November 2026, found through search. Food and drink anchors come from one search of mixed, partly dated travel blogs and budget sites. Those sources gave beer of about INR 180 and a budget meal of $1.50. They also gave a mid-range meal of about $5 per person and coffee of about $1. Alcohol is restricted in Hampi, so beer is scarce and mostly sold across the river. Cocktail and wine prices are estimated from the beer price, with little direct data. Accommodation figures are holistic estimates from general knowledge, not from any listings. Prices may differ in the July 2026 pricing window, since the off-season (April to September) is cheaper.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on small tourist-backpacker towns in Karnataka and South India, such as Gokarna, with Hampi's remote-village pricing.
